title: Width-filter test never exercises a rejected interval
reasoning: The width-filter scenario supplies only an interval of width 1.2 with a minimum of 0.5 and expects inclusion. Removing width filtering entirely would still pass this test. The other supplied collector scenarios use a zero minimum, so they do not protect rejection either.
reproduction: A collector mutation that ignores min_width while preserving interval extraction satisfies all supplied width-related collector assertions.
recommendation: Expand the existing scenario with eligible metrics whose intervals fall below and above the threshold, and assert the exact retained metrics.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No supplied collector test expects an otherwise eligible interval to be excluded because of its width.
suggestedRegressionTest: Parameterize the existing scenario across below-threshold, above-threshold, and explicitly defined boundary behavior.
